description: An error copies between systems in seconds; the correction must be made in each one separately, by hand, in sequence.
energy_note: One mistake, eleven databases, one at a time.

aspect: The burden of proof is entirely his
description: The institution's record is presumed correct; he must produce documents disproving it, frequently from a third country.
energy_note: Presumed wrong about his own life.

description: A date of birth was entered wrong at a consulate in 2011. Every subsequent record inherited it. He is now told his passport does not match his visa history and he should resolve the discrepancy with the issuing authority - which is the body that made the error, and has no record of making it.
energy_note: Told to take it up with the people who did it.
